class.name: LRTVolume
class.brief_description: Local Radiance Transfer solver and local-build resources.
class.description: Owns one local volume: shared conservative coarse geometry, per-instance albedo/emission fields, a persistent bidirectional Trunk candidate index, the analytic comparison path, the direct-light source term and fixed six-face RGB SH4 transport. Geometry fields are process-wide shared by content, precision and algorithm version; material edits therefore do not duplicate or rebuild geometry coverage. Each dirty Trunk temporarily assembles the supported covered affine cells into one spatial hierarchy. Both occupancy and complete probe-neighbor segments query this composite workspace, preserving input order for coincident hits. Workspaces are destroyed before publication, while clean Trunks reuse the prior local results. Local construction intersects complete probe-neighbor segments with closed covered cells; it generates no distance field, surface gradient or interior flood fill. Sky visibility is solved independently from RGB transport while sky reception is enabled.

method.name: clear_shared_sdf_cache
method.description: Clears the process-wide shared geometry registry. Existing volumes keep their active references. Unused geometry is released with its last user without a cache memory budget. Intended for deterministic cache tests and diagnostics.

method.name: build_local_field
method.description: Builds the local field from the configured boxes and uploads it to the GPU. [param backend] is [code]sdf[/code] (coarse geometry coverage) or [code]analytic[/code] (analytic box query). Returns Probe occupancy, surface and mismatch counts.

method.name: estimate_staged_gpu_bytes
method.description: Returns the predicted per-volume GPU allocation for the staged field before upload, including sparse local-record and Source capacity, native light parameters and candidates, propagation mode, and enabled diagnostic fields. Returns zero when no field is staged.

method.name: configure
method.description: Uses the prototype's fixed grid region for the given probe spacing.

method.name: configure_with_bounds
method.description: Uses the prototype's fixed region, expanded so geometry keeps two air cells.

method.name: get_preparation_status
method.description: Returns the live worker preparation phase and completed/total asset count.

method.name: get_grid
method.description: Returns the probe grid (min, size, spacing, width, height, count).

method.name: get_iteration
method.description: Number of completed propagation passes.

method.name: get_pending_step_iterations
method.description: Returns propagation rounds submitted to the render thread but not yet recorded.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns iteration, timing and local field counts. [code]matrix_encoding[/code] is [code]geometry_f32_rgb8_fixed_k[/code]: an achromatic FP32 4×4 matrix, packed linear RGB8 reflectance, and one fixed six-face transport weight. [code]local_record_count[/code] counts live sparse records; [code]local_record_slots[/code] includes released slots retained for reuse. Unchanged contributing probes keep their slot IDs. Black non-emissive surfaces retain their blocking topology without allocating records. [code]local_record_cpu_bytes[/code] includes the sparse 128-byte records with HDR EmissionSH and reserved vector capacity; [code]local_record_index_cpu_bytes[/code] measures the dense Probe-to-slot map, and [code]local_record_allocator_cpu_bytes[/code] measures slot owners and the free list. [code]local_record_capacity[/code] is the allocated GPU slot capacity, with at least one slot for a valid storage binding. Each 128-byte GPU slot contains eight contiguous vec4 values: four G rows, packed reflectance and k, then RGB HDR EmissionSH. Total Source occupies three SH4 vectors per allocated slot instead of per Probe. Capacity growth preserves both local-record banks, Source and their slot IDs; released slots are reused without shrinking the buffers. [code]local_record_upload_cpu_bytes[/code] measures the transient full-record upload copy, released after normal GPU publication. [code]spatial_index_registrations[/code] counts distinct geometry identities (geometry signature, bounds and layer), independent of appearance. Overlapping appearances share a registration but remain separate ordered candidates. [code]spatial_index_candidate_references[/code] counts all Trunk-to-input references. [code]spatial_index_overlap_tests[/code] counts support-box tests in the latest index update; unchanged registrations are reused. [code]spatial_index_payload_bytes[/code] accounts for container and vector payload, excluding map-node and allocator overhead. The index does not retain geometry, material references or prior input versions. [code]geometry_dirty_trunks[/code], [code]reflectance_dirty_trunks[/code] and [code]emission_dirty_trunks[/code] classify the latest update. Geometry changes rebuild occupancy, OpenMask and all record components. Appearance-only changes preserve occupancy and OpenMask: reflectance refreshes rho and k; emission refreshes only EmissionSH. Existing records retain G; newly contributing black surfaces initialize G from the unchanged OpenMask. Static standard-material capture channels retain their published snapshot while their authored dependencies remain unchanged. UV and coverage dependencies affect both channels. Mesh-local captures are reused under instance transforms; ShaderMaterial and animated deformation are not GI geometry inputs. [code]occupancy_probes_updated[/code], [code]geometry_records_built[/code], [code]reflectance_records_updated[/code], [code]emission_records_updated[/code] and [code]transport_weights_updated[/code] count that work. [code]surface_workspaces_built[/code] and [code]surface_workspace_instances[/code] count dirty-Trunk workspaces and their borrowed candidate-grid references in the latest local build. Connectivity uses supercover grid DDA without copied voxel boxes or a BVH. [code]surface_workspace_payload_bytes[/code] is the simultaneous temporary pointer-vector payload, including reserved capacity but excluding workspace objects and allocator overhead; borrowed geometry and material arrays are not included.

method.name: get_performance_stats
method.description: Returns build, transfer and propagation diagnostics. [code]sky_visibility_rounds[/code] and [code]sky_projection_dispatches[/code] count actual sky-visibility propagation rounds and sky-projection dispatches over this solver's lifetime. Appearance-only updates preserve settled sky visibility and do not restart these operations.

method.name: get_memory_stats
method.description: Returns allocated per-volume GPU buffer and texture bytes. [code]local_record_bytes[/code] measures one bank of complete 128-byte sparse records, and [code]source_bytes[/code] measures the three slot-indexed SH4 Source buffers. No CPU surface-receiver pages or GPU receiver buffers are allocated. Native lighting retains 576 bytes of non-spatial parameters per allocated light slot plus Trunk candidate IDs, reported as [code]native_light_state_bytes[/code] and [code]native_light_trunk_bytes[/code]. [code]native_light_input_texture_bytes[/code] counts the owned 1×1 placeholder; shared renderer shadow and light atlases are not owned by the Volume. Per-viewport screen gather outputs are outside this count. Production fields remain in storage buffers; no Volume display textures or temporal display history are allocated.

method.name: get_debug_resources
method.description: Returns native field-buffer RIDs and the latest Gather input/output RIDs, camera, projection, dimensions and render frame for controlled GPU diagnostics. Read RenderingDevice resources on the render thread. Resources remain owned by the solver and viewport; do not free them.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the [code]diagnostic_dirty[/code] local-update texture, or an empty reference for unknown names. When Update Regions is disabled, it uses a 1×1 placeholder. Production fields stay in storage buffers; [method read_field] provides explicit CPU readback. Coarse Geometry shows actual conservative coverage, albedo and emission in one view.

method.name: inject
method.description: Recomposes sparse Source on the render thread without waiting on the main thread. Each active slot starts from its stored HDR EmissionSH. Native lighting is evaluated at the Probe center as incoming SH, then transformed once by G and RGB reflectance before being added to Source. The projection has no receiver cosine or albedo, and transport weights do not scale Source. Recomposition overwrites prior Source, including after lights are changed or deleted. Directional lights use global IDs; local lights use conservative 8×8×8 Trunk candidate lists. Requested native shadows and texture atlases are consumed after the owning view has updated them. Locations outside native shadow coverage still receive unshadowed light. Repeated requests coalesce while one injection is pending.

method.name: is_injection_pending
method.description: Whether a queued source injection has not completed on the render thread.

method.name: read_environment_radiance
method.description: Returns the spherical mean of the engine environment radiance. This is the historical uniform-sky diagnostic; production uses [method read_environment_radiance_sh].

method.name: read_environment_panorama
method.description: Returns Godot's linear HDR environment panorama without display exposure or tone mapping.

method.name: read_environment_radiance_sh
method.description: Projects the engine's linear HDR environment panorama into three RGB SH2 vectors. [param sky_to_local] rotates panorama directions into the solver's local frame. Display exposure and tone mapping are not included.

method.name: project_panorama_radiance_sh
method.description: Projects a linear HDR panorama into three RGB SH2 vectors for diagnostics.

method.name: read_field
method.description: Returns a CPU copy of one production field or local-build diagnostic field for parity and editor checks. [code]external_boundary[/code] contains RGB plus coverage for outgoing face connections, ordered -X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z. Each face is densely stored with its first tangent axis varying fastest; edges and corners retain one sample per outgoing direction. Coverage one includes valid black, while zero denotes no coverage. [code]material[/code] contains four topology values per Probe: reserved zero, blocked-direction count, reserved zero and occupied flag. [code]diagnostic_albedo[/code] decodes the stored RGB8 reflectance, and [code]diagnostic_emission[/code] reconstructs mean blocked-surface emission from EmissionSH DC. Their alpha is one for unoccupied Probes with blocked directions, including black occluders without a sparse record. No per-surface receiver arrays or page-layout diagnostics are retained. [code]matrices[/code] contains five vec4 planes per probe: four rows of achromatic G, followed by bit-packed RGB8 reflectance and one six-face transport weight and two reserved zeros. The reflectance component must be reinterpreted as uint32 bits, not converted numerically. This diagnostic expands sparse slots into Probe order; absent records return zero G and reflectance with unit transport weight. [code]emission_sh_r[/code], [code]emission_sh_g[/code] and [code]emission_sh_b[/code] expand the stored local HDR EmissionSH into four coefficients per Probe. Source readbacks expand slot-indexed GPU data into Probe order, with zero for absent records; native Source debug views use the Probe-to-slot buffer directly. Local cache format 17 persists slot values, Probe indices, slot owners, the free list, coarse-surface samples and independent geometry/reflectance/emission Trunk identities, and invalidates older derived volume caches.

method.name: set_receive_sky
method.description: Controls local sky input. Disabling it stops sky work and removes SkyBounce from the merged Source, while preserving the completed geometry visibility cache.

method.name: read_links
method.description: Returns the 26-bit transport mask per probe.

method.name: read_local_record_indices
method.description: Returns the stable local record slot for each Probe, or [code]-1[/code] when it has no reflection or emission contribution. Occupancy and blocked links remain independent of record presence.

method.name: sample_geometry
method.description: Queries conservative geometry coverage in Volume-local space. Returns [code]occupied[/code], [code]normal[/code], linear [code]albedo[/code] and HDR [code]emission[/code] for a covered cell, or an empty dictionary for air. Closed mesh classification does not fill room interiors. This query does not return a signed distance or extend surface material into air.

method.name: refresh_display
method.description: Reads the current GPU fields back and refreshes the display textures.

method.name: set_boxes
method.description: Sets the analytic box list. Each entry is a dictionary with [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code] and [code]color[/code].

method.name: set_external_gi_enabled
method.description: Allocates external GI input fields only while enabled.

method.name: set_debug_fields
method.description: Selects diagnostic fields for this volume: bit 0 requests source, bit 1 global visibility, bit 3 transfer, bit 4 coarse geometry, bit 5 albedo, bit 6 emission, and bit 7 dirty regions. Bit 2 is unused. Local Visibility reads OpenMask directly and requests no diagnostic atlas. Unselected atlas fields use 1x1 placeholders.

method.name: has_external_gi_buffers
method.description: Returns whether full-size external GI input fields are allocated.

method.name: set_sky
method.description: Sets a uniform environment radiance outside the grid. This creates the exact SH2 constant used by the previous scalar path.

method.name: set_sky_radiance
method.description: Sets directional environment radiance as three RGB SH4 coefficient vectors in Volume-local space. SkyIncoming uses the 26 lattice directions with equal weight 4π/26, the wide projection kernel, and nonnegative reconstructed radiance. Changing color reprojects the last complete visibility mask without restarting its geometry solve.

method.name: get_sky_radiance
method.description: Returns the current three RGB SH2 environment vectors.
